tasks.title: Specify gravitons, deposits and candidate actions
tasks.prompt: Build a bounded candidate registry for ordinary massless tensor gravitons, any explicitly new companion field, and any deposited state. Specify action, symmetries, degrees of freedom, couplings, cutoff and matter frame for each actual candidate. Compare whole-photon mixing, partial energy transfer and field-driven frequency conversion. Identify how each candidate escapes or fails the already derived clock/conformal obstructions. Do not leave arbitrary functions unlimited. Do not activate a candidate that assumes an independent dark-matter component, cosmic expansion or a Big Bang.
completion_criteria: Every candidate has explicit field content and either a defined action or a verdict that no action has yet been supplied.
The deposited state and ordinary gravitational-wave sector are identified without double counting.
Unsupported candidate families are marked incomplete, not accepted.

tasks.title: Derive capture and the stored state
tasks.prompt: Calculate how incident companions can become retained in a weak galaxy potential. Derive cross-sections, optical depths, scattering, focusing, escape/residence and inverse processes. Specify whether capture produces trapped radiation, matter excitations, a condensate or another field; derive its equation of state and heat. For permanent storage, calculate whether detailed balance, saturation, stress and dissipation permit it over the proposed history. A mere rule that deep wells capture more does not complete this task.
completion_criteria: A physically specified capture route has a rate and energy destination, or a quantitative obstruction is shown.
Pressure and confinement are included.
No incoming radiation is assumed cold or permanently trapped solely because gravity is attractive.

user_direction:
# Active research direction — 9 September 2026

User direction: pursue the roadmap in a fictional universe, remain open to alternative physical laws, and ask the user in plain language when a new problematic finding requires choosing a direction. Do not permanently reject a conceptual path without consultation.

Operational interpretation: report what a calculation demonstrates under its explicit assumptions. Keep failed or incompatible assumptions in a branch register as “needs revision / user decision,” not a universal prohibition. Preserve energy conservation and observational targets. Offer concrete alternatives with their costs before choosing a material change of laws. Routine numerical fixes and reproducibility work do not need permission.

Working branches: (A) no companion secondary loss and permanent deposits; (B) shared secondary loss into an explicit receiving sector; (C) finite residence with explicit energy destination; (D) alternative gravitating response or stored state. None is adopted as the final microscopic theory. Do not substitute a different goal just because it is easier to fit.

Current work: T01 baseline reproduction in a scratch copy; T02 specification drafted while it runs; T20 bookkeeping calculations prepared as conditional diagnostics, not a validated mechanism. No automated subagents or scheduled jobs created.
excluded_active_premises: Big Bang initial history or derived standard rulers/chronology
Independent assumed dark-matter component or fitted halo supplied as a source
active_objective: Run the conversion-first prediction checklist with conserved photon/companion/deposit energy, fixed published distances, no required special time/void stretching cause, and all 32 observational requirements. Derive the microscopic interaction, capture/storage and joint motion/lensing response; validate with unexposed data.
